brief:
Medical sources reported that two Palestinians were killed Saturday in separate Israeli strikes in central and southern Gaza, according to IMEMC News. The deaths occurred amid ongoing gunfire, artillery shelling, and military incursions continuing across the coastal enclave throughout the day.

The incidents marked the latest casualties as hostilities persisted across multiple Gaza locations. Residents in both central and southern areas reported hearing sustained fire and explosions. Local sources documented the separate attacks, though full details of each incident remained under investigation as medical personnel attended to the wounded and confirmed the fatalities.
